notes: §2002:7.2.3 GR4: a directive applies to all the text that follows and is independent of execution flow. Every directive of the 2002 set now holds its state by source line: FLAG-85 and FLAG-NATIVE-ARITHMETIC were consumed with no state before kb/Work PB5600 and are folded by FlagState from the line after the directive, so a construct on a later line is flagged however control reaches it.
